SCENE sc_001 0-87910 INT. DUNGEON CELL – DAY
EP38:E1 0-4000 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana slumped on the damp stone floor of her dark dungeon cell, her wrists bound in heavy iron shackles and chains draped over her lap.
EP38:E2 0-3500 ACTION: Juliana sits motionless against the cold masonry, weak and visibly drained from starvation, her eyes cast downward.
EP38:E3 3200-6000 SOUND: Echoing, heavy bootsteps approach down the corridor outside the cell.
EP38:E4 4000-7500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's profile as her head turns toward the corridor, her blue eyes widening with cautious alarm.
EP38:E5 5000-7500 ACTION: Juliana blinks, lifting her gaze toward the heavy iron bars.
EP38:E6 7500-11000 CAMERA: Medium shot through the cell bars as a Guard in a black collared uniform with silver buttons halts outside.
EP38:E7 8500-11000 ACTION: The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.
EP38:E8 11000-15500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot focusing on the wet flagstones at the base of the cell door.
EP38:E9 11000-15500 ACTION: The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.
EP38:E10 15500-17500 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling forward across the stone floor toward the bread, her gaze fixed on the offering in disbelief.
EP38:E11 16000-17300 JULIANA [Breathless, Bewildered]: "Why?"
EP38:E12 17500-21500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Guard looking through the vertical bars with quiet compassion.
EP38:E13 17500-20300 GUARD [Subdued, Sincere]: "Because no one should die hungry."
EP38:E14 20500-22000 GUARD [Urgent, Whispered]: "Eat it before they see."
EP38:E15 21500-23200 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.
EP38:E16 21800-23200 ACTION: The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.
EP38:E17 23200-30500 CAMERA: Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.
EP38:E18 23500-27500 ACTION: Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.
EP38:E19 26000-27500 JULIANA [Choked Up, Tearful]: "Thank you."
EP38:E20 27800-31000 ACTION: Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
EP38:E21 30500-35000 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.
EP38:E22 31000-34500 ACTION: Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.
EP38:E23 34500-36500 JULIANA [Sorrowful, Whispering]: "Alexander..."
EP38:E24 35000-39500 CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of Juliana seated against the damp stone wall beneath high overhead iron ceiling grates, clutching the half-eaten bread in her lap.
EP38:E25 36800-39000 JULIANA [Yearning]: "...are you safe?"
EP38:E26 39500-45500 CAMERA: Intimate close-up of Juliana looking upward, her tear-stained face filled with raw anguish.
EP38:E27 40000-43000 JULIANA [Desperate, Trembling]: "Do you even know what happened to me?"
EP38:E28 43200-45200 JULIANA [Grief-Stricken]: "Do you know they condemned me?"
EP38:E29 45500-51000 CAMERA: Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.
EP38:E30 45500-47500 JULIANA [Fearful, Pleading]: "What if I die here?"
EP38:E31 47800-50500 JULIANA [Heartbroken]: "What if I never see you again?"
EP38:E32 48500-51000 ACTION: A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
EP38:E33 51000-55500 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.
EP38:E34 51500-53500 JULIANA [Fervent Prayer]: "Keep him safe."
EP38:E35 53800-55300 JULIANA [Resigned]: "Wherever he is."
EP38:E36 55500-60500 CAMERA: Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.
EP38:E37 55500-57000 JULIANA [Determined]: "Let him live."
EP38:E38 57500-60500 JULIANA [Steely]: "And if I have only one thing left to give..."
EP38:E39 60500-64000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.
EP38:E40 60800-62500 JULIANA [Defiant, Unshakable]: "I will not give them my husband."
EP38:E41 62800-64200 JULIANA [Resolute]: "I will not betray him."
EP38:E42 64000-67000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.
EP38:E43 64500-66500 ACTION: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.
EP38:E44 64800-87000 SOUND: Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.
EP38:E45 67000-70500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.
EP38:E46 69000-70300 JULIANA [Startled Whisper]: "Bells."
EP38:E47 70500-72500 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.
EP38:E48 71000-73500 ACTION: Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
EP38:E49 72500-78500 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.
EP38:E50 72800-74200 JULIANA [Realizing]: "The wedding."
EP38:E51 74500-75800 JULIANA [Grim]: "It's beginning."
EP38:E52 76000-78500 JULIANA [Somber, Steely]: "Then I suppose I'm next."
EP38:E53 78500-84500 CAMERA: Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.
EP38:E54 81000-84000 ACTION: Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.
EP38:E55 82500-84000 JULIANA [Hopeful, Tender]: "Alexander..."
EP38:E56 84500-87910 CAMERA: Dramatic cut to black.
EP38:E57 84500-87910 SOUND: A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.
